tasks.title: Report animation only when something actually moves
tasks.detail: Both profiles raise the plain animation note on any stage with a time range, including one whose animation is trivial or absent in practice. Probe instead: does any exported prim's local-to-world or a tracked attribute vary across start/middle/end? Report only then, and say which.

The recurring failure this session was prose drifting from code, which green tests never caught.
